spots.name: Springtime in TR
spots.blurb: You've reached Springtime in TR, a mural by Emily Clanton from 2017. Public mural by Emily Clanton. Permanent exterior latex paint on a cinderblock wall on Main Street in downtown Travelers Rest, SC. Created in 2017 with Furman University MayX students, it celebrates local landscape and the Swamp Rabbit Trail.
